mapper.select: select * from (select m.*, r.update_time as white_time,r.remark as white_reason,r.id as white_id,r.create_user as white_create_by from safety_build_white_rule r left join safety_employee_message m on m.position_name like concat('%',r.post_name,'%') and r.delete_flag = '0' where m.status = 'NORMAL' and r.post_name is not null union all select m.*, r.update_time as white_time,r.remark as white_reason,r.id as white_id,r.create_user as white_create_by from safety_build_white_rule r left join safety_employee_message m on r.delete_flag = '0' and find_in_set(r.org_code, m.org_code_path) > 0 where m.status = 'NORMAL' and r.org_code is not null) s order by s.white_time desc
